en.text: Pride Hire handles flex printing in Muzaffarnagar as design plus print in one place. We design the artwork, place the order with a local printer and coordinate the job, so you deal with us instead of briefing a printer yourself. The printing itself is done by the printer, not by us.

en.text: What does flex printing with Pride Hire include?

sections.1.answer.context: Section 1 answer, directly under its heading (self-contained, 40-60 words)

en.text: Design and print handled in one place. We design the artwork, place the order with a local printer in Muzaffarnagar and coordinate the job, so you deal with us instead of briefing a printer yourself. The printing itself is done by the printer, not by us.

sections.2.heading.context: Section 2 heading (H2) — the question a buyer asks

en.text: Flex board banwane ke liye kya chahiye? (What do I need to give you?)

sections.2.answer.context: Section 2 answer, directly under its heading (self-contained, 40-60 words)

en.text: Tell us what the flex is for and where it will be displayed, the size you need, and the text, logo and phone numbers to include. If you do not have a design, we create one. We agree the design with you before it is sent for printing.

sections.3.heading.context: Section 3 heading (H2) — the question a buyer asks

sections.3.answer.context: Section 3 answer, directly under its heading (self-contained, 40-60 words)

en.text: Printing is done by a local printer in Muzaffarnagar that we work with. We do not own printing equipment. We handle the design, place the order and coordinate with the printer, so you have one point of contact for the whole job instead of dealing with two businesses.
